entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-w7jw-789q-3m8p: shell-quote quote() does not escape newlines in object .op values
entry.content:
shell-quote quote() does not escape newlines in object .op values

Aliases: CVE-2026-9277

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • shell-quote — fixed in 1.8.4

### Summary `shell-quote`'s `quote()` function did not validate object-token inputs against the operator model used by `parse()`. The `.op` field was backslash-escaped character by character using `/(.)/g`, which in JavaScript does not match line terminators (`\n`, `\r`, U+2028, U+2029).
